figurative_meaning_en: A young boy; a nursing infant
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এখনও দুধের ছেলে, অনেক কিছু বোঝে না।
গ্রামের ছেলেরা দুধের ছেলের মতো নির্দোষ।
example_sentences_in_english: He is still a young boy and doesn't understand much.
The village boys are innocent like nursing infants.
note: Refers to a male child still dependent on mother's milk, emphasizing tenderness and immaturity in Bengali familial context.
